skill.displayName: Bitcoin Wallet for Agents using Arkade
skill.summary: Send and receive Bitcoin over Arkade (offchain), onchain (via onboard/offboard), and Lightning. Swap USDC/USDT stablecoins.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Wallet initialization (`init` command) now always requires user confirmation and cannot run implicitly; all other commands require a wallet to be initialized first.
- Updated documentation to clarify the `init` requirement and proper user confirmation before first-time wallet setup.
- Minor clarifications to agent safety rules.
